content: In case usage of a FIFO-Buffer (see PduRQueueDepth ) if the destination communication interface module is requesting the I-PDU buffer using PduR_<DstLo>TriggerTransmit and the FIFO is empty the return value E_NOT_ OK shall be used.

If trigger transmit data provision is used with a FIFO: when the destination comunication interface module is requesting the I-PDU buffer using PduR_<DstLo>TriggerTransmit and the FIFO is empty the return value E_NOT_OK shall be used.
